name: Tiana's Herbed Brioche with Roasted Onion Dip
whyItWorks: Soft enriched white brioche is completely seedless and low-residue; the FODMAP risk lies solely in the roasted onion cream dip.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy the warm herbed brioche with plain butter rather than the heavy roasted onion dip if sensitive to onion fructans.
